steps.en: Offender passes the check that all arrest warrants were permanently suspended within X months
steps.id: Offender lolos pengecekan bahwa semua warrant of arrest permanently suspended dalam X bulan
steps.why_en: No such check exists; the only eligibility logic found is for furnishing driver details.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan itu tidak ada; satu-satunya logika kelayakan yang ditemukan untuk furnish data pengemudi.

steps.en: The system creates the clearance slip as a PDF
steps.id: Sistem membuat clearance slip dalam bentuk PDF
steps.why_en: Only a generic PDF tool and a payment receipt exist; no clearance slip content is built.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada alat PDF umum dan receipt pembayaran; isi clearance slip belum dibuat.

steps.en: The clearance slip gets a unique serial number
steps.id: Clearance slip mendapat nomor seri unik
steps.why_en: Nothing generates a serial number for the slip; the only number is a payment receipt number.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang membuat nomor seri untuk slip; satu-satunya nomor adalah nomor receipt pembayaran.

steps.en: The slip is shown to the offender on the portal
steps.id: Slip ditampilkan kepada offender di portal
steps.why_en: The portal has only payment and furnish pages; no page shows a clearance slip.
steps.why_id: Portal hanya punya halaman pembayaran dan furnish; tidak ada halaman yang menampilkan clearance slip.

steps.en: The offender downloads the clearance slip PDF
steps.why_en: The only download is a payment receipt, unrelated to warrants.
steps.why_id: Satu-satunya unduhan adalah receipt pembayaran, tidak terkait warrant.

steps.en: The offender prints a copy of the slip
steps.why_en: There is no print option because no slip page exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pilihan cetak karena halaman slip belum ada.
